faq.q: can ai read a birth chart?
faq.a: yes, in two parts. software calculates the planetary positions exactly from ur birth date, time and place. a language model can then explain those positions in plain words. the reading is only as good as the calculation underneath it.

a general chatbot can explain a kundli u paste into it. asked to calculate one from scratch, it may guess positions instead of computing them, because it is predicting text rather than running an ephemeris. always check its planets against a real calculator.

the astronomy can be accurate to a fraction of a degree when a proper ephemeris is used. the interpretation is as accurate as astrology itself, which is a traditional interpretive system rather than a tested science. ai does not change that, it only changes the delivery.

a table of where every planet is at every moment. modern astrology software uses computed ephemerides like the swiss ephemeris, which is based on nasa jpl data. it is the part of a chart that is pure astronomy.

faq.q: how do i know if an ai astrology app calculated my chart properly?
faq.a: check three things against any reputable kundli calculator: ur lagna, ur moon sign and ur moon nakshatra. if those three match, the calculation is sound. if they do not, nothing built on top of them can be trusted.

faq.q: is ai astrology better than a human astrologer?
faq.a: they are good at different things. ai is fast, patient, available at 2am and consistent. an experienced astrologer brings judgement about which factors matter most in a specific chart and context about ur life. neither should promise certainty.

faq.q: does ai astrology use vedic or western astrology?
faq.a: it depends entirely on the app. vedic apps use the sidereal zodiac with an ayanamsa such as lahiri. western apps use the tropical zodiac. ask tota is vedic and uses lahiri. if an app does not say which it uses, that is worth noticing.

no more than astrology can. vedic astrology describes tendencies and timing windows through dashas and transits. an ai can explain those clearly, but anyone, human or machine, claiming certainty about events is overselling.

faq.q: why do different ai astrology apps give different readings?
faq.a: different ayanamsas, different house systems, different emphasis in interpretation, and different writing styles. if two apps disagree on ur moon sign, one of them is using a different zodiac or a wrong birth time, not reading a different sky.

faq.q: is it safe to give my birth details to an ai astrology app?
faq.a: read the privacy policy. birth date, time and place are personal data. look for whether the data is sold, whether it goes to a third party ai provider, and whether u can delete it. ask tota discloses that readings are generated by a third party ai provider and lets u delete everything in app.

the ashtakoota score is a fixed calculation from two moon nakshatras, so software does it perfectly. what ai adds is an explanation of each koota and of the score in context. the number itself should never depend on the model's mood.

faq.q: what can ai not do in astrology?
faq.a: it cannot know ur life unless u tell it, it cannot fix a wrong birth time, and it cannot make astrology more scientifically proven than it is. it also should not stand in for medical, legal, financial or mental health advice.
